title: Supply, Installation and commissioning of CCTV system at East Island Lighthouse and DGNSS Station under Sri Vijaya Puram Directorate.
summary: E-tender for supply, installation and commissioning of a CCTV system at East Island Lighthouse and DGNSS Station, Andaman Islands, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair).
